lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
The Halloween on Church Street event in Toronto sees a large number of people gather downtown, but this year’s event raised multiple issues, CityNews reports.
Canada on the minds of American voters ahead of the U.S. midterm elections, CityNews Winnipeg reports.
The University of Toronto has issued a shelter-in-place order for its Mississauga campus as Peel police respond to what they are calling an “active incident,” The Canadian Press reports.
Thursday’s federal budget will look to make life easier for Canada’s small- and medium-sized businesses, says Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne, The Canadian Press reports.
What is Donald Trump’s closing message to voters?, The Canadian Press reports.
JD Vance says Haley Stevens’ endorsement of GOP’s Mike Rogers will ‘certainly’ help Michigan Senate race, Fox News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
